question: When original recorded observation methods AND actual calendar-date windows are restricted together, which source-confirmed site×taxon positives disappear, including those with a method-positive witness and a time-window-positive witness that occur on DIFFERENT raw rows? How do recorded wetland-category contrast signs depend on the joint gate?

source.article: Wenner et al. (2025), Global Ecology and Conservation 62 e03837; original data Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.15044115 CC BY 4.0

cohorts.original_Q1: 27 original Q1 sites excluding kis-banyato and vadasz-turjan, 351 source rows, 117 site×calendar-date groups, nine taxa, 144 full-positive site×taxon pairs, AV full-calendar positives 104
cohorts.original_Q2: 13 intervention source sites, 188 rows, 64 site×date groups, nine taxa, 77 full-positive pairs, AV full-calendar positives 61; strict Q1 subset

fixed_gates.source_positive: any original CSV count>0 on source rows at a given original site and taxon; repeated bottletrap keys preserved
fixed_gates.F_all: positive from any of four original recorded methods across any original source dates
fixed_gates.M_all: positive from acoustic OR visual across all dates; one source row of each method required at every site×recorded date
fixed_gates.F_window: positive from any four methods on site dates at most h calendar days from site's earliest or latest original recorded date inclusive
fixed_gates.M_window: positive from acoustic or visual rows on those SAME selected dates, not separately choosing a different window for the method panel
fixed_gates.mathematical_support: M_window ⊆ M_all ∩ F_window ⊆ F_all, but M_window may be a PROPER subset of M_all ∩ F_window when the witnesses occur at different times/methods
five_disjoint_source_positive_classes: method_only_marginal: F_window \ M_all (inside window extra methods only across any date)
time_only_marginal: M_all \ F_window (AV positive only outside window, all methods zero inside)
split_witness_interaction: (F_window ∩ M_all) \ M_window (extra method positive inside window AND AV positive outside)
excluded_by_either_gate_alone: F_all \ (F_window ∪ M_all) (extra method positive outside window only)

metrics: For each original Q1 and Q2 cohort, anchor and horizon, counts for all five disjoint positive-witness classes and full/AV/window/joint positive witness masks; verify class sum to 144/77.

First/last source window 7×2×two-method panels counts, full independent method gate baseline, non-decreasing first/last window positivity and 91-day all positive recovery; all paired method inclusions.

For each source-positive site×taxon, original first positive source date per method and first/last window support, witness class, and the exact split-witness timing/method path; include source row IDs and dates where useful.

For original Q1 groups intervention=13, control=6, artificial=8 and all nine taxa, calculate 27 source-positive-site-fraction contrasts for each of 14 window positions × 2 method panels = 756 rows. Compare strict sign reversals vs original F_all and within-window F_window (only for matching AV window). Count ties separately, all integer cross-product signs.
For Q2, report cohort time×method source witness changes and per-species categories, no Q2 wetland-category comparisons because all 13 Q2 sites intervention.
Report number of true ecological biological absences established = 0, original occupancy model fits = 0, new EOG-WF scored endpoints = 0.
Machine result fingerprint plus 14-window Q1/Q2 summary rows, positive site×taxon×window rows, 756 contrasts, original source CSV sha guards, synthetic CI controls.
interpretive_stops: The five classes are a decomposition of RECORDED SOURCE POSITIVE SUPPORT only; do not attribute missingness to causal detectability vs phenology vs colonization or use terms true false negative.

Joint gates commute at the original-row filtering level; a split-witness interaction means site×species-level separately aggregated positive sets do not commute with time/method gate intersection, not that physical operations are noncommutative.
Site windows and method pairs do not establish equal effort, independence, field method deployment or biological closure (up to 91 days).
Missing original CSV method row does not prove field nondeployment; paper states dipnet in ordinary site surveys.

The 756 observed contrast signs are deterministic post-exposure repeated calculations on same source, not independent tests, restoration causal effects, p-values, occupancy estimates, A/B/M processes or actual ecological world counts.
Keep PR #697 Draft/unmerged and frozen EOG-WF 3 scored/31 scientific STOP/3 administrative exclusions unchanged.
